_note: The jackpot roll: a stacking 5 percent per chest for diamond or netherite equipment carrying five distinct random enchantments. It is an extra roll, so a chest can carry the ordinary equipment roll and the jackpot together. The empty entry weighs 95 times the 18 tag members, because an expanded tag entry adds its members weights together: 1710 against 18 times 5 keeps the pool at 5 percent.
